deckTitle: It’s All About Me! (And Also FrizzleBob)

cards.name: The Pond-Gazing Peacock
cards.power: Mirror Lock. Skip 3 turns. If water ripples, take 5 Emotional Damage.
cards.lore: I'd help you, but I'm currently busy existing as a visual masterpiece.
cards.gradeReason: Perfect opener—self-obsession weaponized into peacock theology.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: vanity satire comic. Subject: peacock admiring reflection endlessly. Mood: majestic narcissism.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p2 TL

rating.reason: Power spiegelt das Motiv (Kräuseln stört das Spiegelbild) und ist klar spielbar; Narcissus-Anspielung ist da, Lore und Bild bleiben erwartbar.

cards.name: The Flexing Rooster
cards.power: Intimidating Decor. Use antlers in decorating to gain +2 Presence.
cards.lore: No one spits like me. I am nature's special effect.
cards.gradeReason: Loud rooster ego card is funny and instantly readable, but simpler than Peacock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: absurd farm comic. Subject: rooster flexing beside eggs. Mood: loud confidence.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p2 TR

rating.reason: Kein erkennbarer Witz: Geweih beim Hahn ergibt keine Pointe, die Power ist unklar ('Presence' ist kein Deck-Wert) und das Bild zeigt Hahn mit Eiern statt Posieren.

cards.name: The Portrait Poodle
cards.power: Dorian's Pact. Transfer physical damage to the card in hand.
cards.lore: The painting ages so I don't have to. Don't look in the attic.
cards.gradeReason: Vanity dog plus cursed portrait is elegant and brutally on theme.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: gothic satire comic. Subject: poodle staring at aging portrait. Mood: elegant denial.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p2 BL

rating.reason: Dorian-Gray-Umkehrung (zerzauster Pudel schaut auf Welpenporträt) sitzt im Bild, Lore ist allein zitierbar; die Power ('card in hand') bleibt vage.

cards.name: The Selfie-Stick Swan
cards.power: Crop & Filter. Remove 'Negative Vibes' tokens. Ignore reality.
cards.lore: If I didn't post it, did the forest really burn down? Doubtful.
cards.gradeReason: Swan documenting disaster for clout is vicious modern narcissism.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: social media satire comic. Subject: swan taking selfie by fire. Mood: glamorous disaster.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p2 BR

rating.reason: Schwan macht Selfie vor brennendem Wald, die Lore dreht 'fällt der Baum' treffend; 'Negative Vibes tokens' sind im Deck nicht definiert.

cards.name: The Fog-Weaving Cuttlefish
cards.power: Rewrite History. Force opponent to discard last card and apologize.
cards.lore: I never said that. And if I did, you made me say it.
cards.gradeReason: Gaslighting squid is one of the cleanest mechanics in the whole concept.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: manipulative comic. Subject: cuttlefish blowing fog over argument. Mood: slippery denial.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p3 TL

rating.reason: Gaslighting als klare Mechanik (Karte abwerfen und entschuldigen), Lore ist das Verleugnen-und-Umkehren-Skript in einem Satz; Bild mit umgeschriebenen Erinnerungen im Nebel trägt nur teilweise.

cards.name: The Mockingbird
cards.power: Tone Policing. Negate argument by repeating it in a whiny voice.
cards.lore: You're crazy. You're imagining things. You're just like your mother.
cards.gradeReason: Classic abuse script turned into a bird fight—perfect table poison.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: emotional satire comic. Subject: mockingbird yelling at smaller bird. Mood: cruel mimicry.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p3 TR

rating.reason: Power ist klar und spiegelt den Spottdrossel-Namen (Nachäffen); die Lore ist eine Aufzählung typischer Floskeln und braucht die Karte.

cards.name: The Lure-Light Anglerfish
cards.power: Love Bomb. Offer a gift. If accepted, swallow opponent whole next turn.
cards.lore: Mother knows best. Stay in the dark. It's dangerous out there.
cards.gradeReason: Predator romance card is dark, funny, and mechanically excellent.
cards.artworkPrompt: Style: deep sea horror comic. Subject: anglerfish glowing with false warmth. Mood: seductive danger.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p3 BL

rating.reason: Köder-Herz und Love Bombing greifen ineinander, die Power spiegelt das Motiv; die Lore handelt von der Mutter und passt nur halb zur Karte.

cards.power: Alternative Facts. Change game rules mid-turn.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p3 BR

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p4 TR

cards.artworkPrompt: Style: PR satire comic. Subject: dolphin crying for cameras. Mood: manipulative innocence.

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p4 BL

rating.reason: Bild (Delfin beißt blutigen Arm in Handschellen) macht die Lore-Pointe 'Yes, it is murder' dunkel anschaulich; 'Support' ist kein Deck-Wert, die Power bleibt vage.

cards.name: The Medal-Heavy General

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p4 BR

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p5 TL

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p5 TR

textSource.source: PDF FrizzleBob_s_Ego_Mania_NARCISSIST - ADD web ID.pdf p5 BL

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: IT'S ALL ABOUT ME! – A Field Guide to Narcissists, Their Enablers, and the Exit Door (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Narcissism is a one-actor play that quietly drafts everyone else in the room into the supporting cast.

You know the dinner where one person's mood sets the weather for eight other people. The sulk that reorganizes the whole evening, the grievance rehearsed so often it has stage directions, the apology you somehow end up being the one to give. Nobody named the parts out loud, so you kept playing yours: audience, stagehand, understudy for the blame. That is the entire trick. The show only runs as long as the cast keeps showing up on cue.

This is Social Story Wrestling for the family system you were taught to stay polite about. 48 cut-and-play cards rate every player on three stats, Rage (how loud it gets when you say no), Adoration (how many likes it needs to survive the round), and Fraud (how thick the mask is), and the table decides who actually wins the scene.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The "It's All About Me!" Core Deck: 48 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring The Spiteful Wasp, The Cross-Bearing Donkey, and The Truth Bomb.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook, titled "How to Wrestle a Pig (Without Getting Dirty)". No complicated math, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the discipline of not taking the bait.
- The RAF Engine: the narcissist archetypes, the enablers and scapegoats who keep them fed, and the hazard, counter, and structure cards that run all the way to The Exit Door.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because naming the move is the first thing that takes its power away, and most people learn the pattern years too late, alone, and convinced the whole thing was their own fault. Are you broke, or counting every coin this month? Enter "0" and take it. Play it. Name the types out loud until they stop sounding like fate. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the next deck.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"The narcissist only owns the spotlight you agree to keep holding. Set it down and walk."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
